packet_size.locator: B912 system-level baseline: FTP model 3 with 0.5 Mbyte payload and mean inter-arrival time of 200 ms; B947 R2 'FTP traffic 0.5 Mbytes'
packet_size.interpretation: Fixed application packet size in decimal Mbyte definition (500000 bytes = 4000000 bits); not MiB and not a PHY transport block.

mean_interarrival.locator: B912; B947 R3 'Mean inter-arrival time: 200 ms'
mean_interarrival.interpretation: Mean inter-arrival time of the Poisson (exponential inter-arrival) arrival process; the arrival process and the size/mean values are recorded separately.

pdb_ms.locator: reviewed config_reviewed.yaml qos.delay_budget_ms and W02_TRAFFIC.md step 2
pdb_ms.interpretation: Self-reported engineering delay budget used only to fill Packet.deadline_ns; it is not a 3GPP requirement for this traffic type.

arrival_quantization.interpretation: Continuous-time arrival instants are quantized to the nearest integer nanosecond with round-half-up; the absolute quantization error is at most 0.5 ns and arrivals are never snapped onto a DRX, measurement or WUS grid.

ip_mtu_bytes.locator: W02_TRAFFIC.md step 7; TR 38.838 section 5.1.1 (B440/B441) defines the frame-level packet as a set of IP packets but no IP packet size
ip_mtu_bytes.interpretation: Engineering IP payload cap used to split a frame into IP packets; headers and padding are not modelled, so IP payload bits sum exactly to the frame bits.

tb_max_bits.locator: B976: one 10-symbol PDSCH in a slot carries 868584 information bits (FR1 100 MHz calibration assumption)
tb_max_bits.interpretation: Wireless transport-block payload cap for the reviewed calibration reference; W02 only splits payload bits and assigns no radio resources.

metadata.arrival_process: FTP model 3: Poisson arrivals with a fixed finite file size
metadata.scope_note: Path-A abstract input; paired cases use the same traffic stream and hash.
